concepts.prompt: Create realistic, production-quality native iPhone UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. Generate a NEW design for Potato, a Chinese-language AI chat and remote computer task app. Use attached images only as design references: image 1 is the existing Potato UI to simplify; image 2 is the existing Potato brand mark to preserve; image 3 ChatGPT reference for quiet content-first layout, image 4 Grok reference for modes near the composer, image 5 Claude reference for whitespace. Do NOT copy competitor logos or marketing frames. Target dimensions: one 390 x 844 app-content viewport, rendered sharp at high resolution with the same natural ratio. No device bezel, phone body, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, clock, battery, signal, home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask or shadow outside the app. One focused primary screen only, not multiple panels or a contact sheet. Current date anchor 2026-09-13; no dates needed in UI. Potato style: warm off-white #F8F7F4 background, charcoal #20201D, subtle warm grey #F0EFEB, SF Pro/PingFang style typography, minimal SF Symbols, at least 44pt hit areas, body 16-17pt, concise readable Chinese. No gradients, no dashboard metrics, no decorative cards, no illustration besides the supplied little Potato mark. Space and alignment first, dividers second, surfaces third, borders/shadows only sparingly. Main purpose: effortlessly start a new task or continue work on a chosen computer. The user explicitly wants a much simpler home, working sidebar swipes, accessible model and thinking settings, and clear thinking feedback. This image explores the HOME, leaving sidebar and thinking-progress details offscreen. Show the target computer clearly but quietly, and a model/thinking shortcut close to input. Render all requested Chinese text exactly. The view is an empty new remote conversation with connected target 'MacBook Pro'; no fake messages or fake generating status. No separate grid of project/feature cards, no always-visible full chat/project list. Make the input visually the main actionable object.  Direction name: 留白对话. Calm, balanced minimal home. Top bar: sidebar icon left, centered Potato wordmark 19pt, new-chat pencil icon right. Immediately below, a small text-style target selector with laptop icon, green status dot, 'MacBook Pro' and chevron, center aligned. In the mid upper area around 38% height, center the supplied tiny Potato mark at 36pt above a single headline '想做点什么？' at 26pt semibold. No subtitle, no greeting paragraphs, no suggestions, no recents. Generous uninterrupted whitespace. Bottom anchored composer about 115pt tall with 18pt side insets, warm white, subtle thin border, 26pt radius. Top text line inside: '给电脑发个任务…'. Bottom row: plus icon, light quiet pill '模型 · 跟随电脑' with down chevron, separate text control '思考 · 默认', and a black circular microphone button aligned at the far right. Keep labels fitting legibly on a 390pt screen by wrapping model/thinking row deliberately if needed, but do not shrink to tiny font. No disabled send arrow when input empty; voice is the only dark primary action. Fine bottom safe content spacing. Minimal, confident native application, home as an invitation to write.
